en.summary: You may get several help schemes. Father can get 6,000 rupees a year in the PM-KISAN scheme, paid in three parts into the bank account. Daughter can get 12,000 rupees in the Kanya Sumangala scheme when she joins school and college. The housing scheme can give about 1,20,000 rupees to build a pucca house, after a check. Go to your CSC or Jan Seva Kendra with all papers. Insurance is protection, not a direct payment.

cards.where_to_apply: Your bank branch, post office, or bank's online or mobile app.
